c1.title: Raven Concept A — Anatomical Folded Raven
c1.tagline: Believable volume, a layered three-tier wing and a strong soaring profile. Gliding pose.
c1.provenance: Sheet A v4 (after independent review rounds 1–3) · 2026-11-27 · Blender 5.2.1 maquette render (c1_anatomical.py) + Pillow compositing · Common Raven (Corvus corax)
c1.hero_sub: neutral paper, single key light, crease lines drawn by the renderer
notes: Pose: soaring glide, ~3° dihedral, slotted fingers, flat wings.
Primary: one continuous spine bill – nape – body – wedge tail,
with a neck waist, nape step and rounded breast.
Secondary: thick leading-edge band, covert tier, rounded
secondaries; 10 primaries: 4 long fingers (P6–P9), short P10.
Tertiary: bristle flap, throat hackles, eye facet, alula.
Maquette: span/length 1.94; tail 0.37 L; bill ~0.10 L.
Risk: ~1000 faces; tiers merge below ~24 px, so a district
LOD keeps the spine, wedge and fingers only.
v2–v4 fixes: dorsal fin, bill hook, keel, rake, hackle strip.
Concept artwork only; foldability NOT VERIFIED.

c2.title: Raven Concept B — Sumi Sculptural Raven
c2.tagline: Few, large, purposeful folds and a bold silhouette. Perched on a ruin post, calling. Flight study on sheet B-2.
c2.provenance: Sheet B v4 (after independent review rounds 1–3) · 2026-11-27 · Blender 5.2.1 maquette render (c2_sumi.py) + Pillow compositing · Common Raven (Corvus corax)
c2.hero_sub: neutral paper; post is context only, not part of the concept

labels.tail_wedge_tip: keeled wedge tail, modestly past wingtips

notes: Pose: perched, compact neck, bill open — the calling display.
Primary: plump pentagonal-section body, short neck, domed head
with the eye mid-head (after Kyōsai's crows).
Secondary: covert leaf, secondary tier, one primary blade;
keeled three-blade wedge tail extending past the wingtips.
Tertiary: five-shard hackle beard, stout legs, eye.
~260 faces: detail budget spent on gesture, not feathers.
Flight state: banked glide on sheet B-2, same plane language.
v2–v4 fixes: nape, eye, bill, hackle strip, tail, breast.
Post is context: hidden in silhouette and district tests.
Concept artwork only; foldability NOT VERIFIED.

c3.title: Raven Concept C — Modular Tessellated Raven
c3.tagline: One folded shingle module in three sizes, confined to wing and tail tracts over a calm hull. Upstroke.
c3.provenance: Sheet C v2 (after independent review round 1; round 2: NO-GO as a separate direction) · 2026-11-27 · Blender 5.2.1 maquette render (c3_modular.py) + Pillow compositing
c3.hero_sub: neutral paper; dark hull visible between shingle rows
close: Hand — pleated fan of L modules
notes: Pose: upstroke, ~16° arm dihedral, hand swept back.
One module (folded chevron shingle) × three sizes S/M/L:
95 placements (S 38, M 16, L 41), one definition.
Primary: calm hull + raven head (shared anatomy with A).
Secondary: S/M/L wing rows; tail wedge by root stagger.
Tertiary: S-module hackles, eye.
v2: body rings removed after review (pangolin read),
conical head replaced, inner wing tapered.
Weakness kept: raised-wing side view is a dense comb.
Concept artwork only; foldability NOT VERIFIED.

c2f.title: Raven Concept B-2 — Sumi Sculptural Raven, flight study
c2f.tagline: The same plane language in flight: banked glide, tapered folded arm, four finger blades, keeled wedge.
c2f.provenance: Sheet B-2 v3 (after independent review rounds 2–3) · 2026-11-27 · Blender 5.2.1 maquette render (c2f_sumi_flight.py) + Pillow compositing · Common Raven (Corvus corax)
notes: Purpose: show B can fly without changing its language.
Arm: covert band folded over a tapered secondary plane
with three notched pleats; chord tapers root to wrist.
Hand: inner primaries continue the trailing edge as one
tapering plane; 4 long fingers + short leading P10 beyond.
Tail: keeled three-blade wedge, diamond outline below.
Bank 14° gives the asymmetric signature (¾) silhouette.
~210 faces. v2/v3: no palm; diagonal hand taper; fanned fingers.
Concept artwork only; foldability NOT VERIFIED.
